works.title: Relativity: The Special and the General Theory — 3rd edition
works.source: Lawson’s authorised translation, 3rd ed. · Project Gutenberg #36114 · public domain
works.note: The preferred reading text. 738 equations survive as renderable LaTeX because this is a data-tex build.

works.title: Relativity — the #5001 production
works.source: Lawson’s authorised 1920 translation · Project Gutenberg #5001 · public domain
works.note: The same book as 01a, retained for Appendix IV. ~33,500 words; Appendix V is absent and still in copyright. Its 233 equations are spoken-form only, not typeset.

works.title: The Meaning of Relativity — the Princeton lectures, 1921
works.source: Princeton lectures, May 1921 · Project Gutenberg #36276 · public domain
works.note: Lectures I–IV only, a carve-out resolved as cleanly public domain. 1,165 equations as renderable LaTeX — the most mathematics in the room.

works.title: Sidelights on Relativity — two addresses
works.source: Leyden 1920 and Berlin 1921 · Project Gutenberg #7333 · public domain
works.note: Complete, ~8,400 words, pure prose. Read “Geometry and Experience” first: it is where Einstein comes closest to writing philosophy rather than physics, and it is short.

works.title: Fundamental Ideas and Problems — the Nobel lecture
works.source: Gothenburg, 11 July 1923 · Project Gutenberg #69572 · public domain
works.note: The shortest text here, ~3,800 words, and the best formula fidelity in the set: all 38 equations as real LaTeX.

works.title: On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies
works.source: Annalen der Physik, 1905 · 1923 Methuen line via the Walker edition · public domain
works.note: The special relativity paper, ~8,600 words. One damaged page: the conversion dropped p. 22, and with it the closing acknowledgement to Michele Besso.

works.title: Über die spezielle und die allgemeine Relativitätstheorie — the German original
works.source: Einstein’s own language, 1917 · Project Gutenberg #77850 · public domain
works.note: Incomplete or an early printing — unresolved. Breaks off around the English Ch. XXV; Part III and the appendices are absent. Formulae are text rather than images, so notation survives better here than in the English.

works.title: The Principle of Relativity — Calcutta, 1920
works.source: Saha and Bose translation, with Minkowski · Project Gutenberg #66944 · public domain
works.note: Complete at ~60,500 words but the wrong edition — the Saha/Bose line rather than the 1923 Methuen. Contains the abridged 1905 paper; Besso is confirmed absent. Kept as a variant and as reception history.

works.title: Manifest — editions, provenance, carve-outs
works.note: Which edition was taken and why, what was refused, and where the room is knowingly imperfect. Read before citing.

works.title: Link-outs — what stays a link, and why
works.note: The reception shelf, the Princeton documentary edition, and the walled post-1929 writing.

works.title: The Digital Einstein Papers
works.note: The full documentary edition, openly readable. The modern translations carry their own rights — link out, do not corpus.
